   comps.append(comp)
print([(len(x),[(r+1,c+1) for r,c in x]) for x in comps])
for comp in comps:
 if len(comp)>1:
  for r,c in comp:g[r][c]=8
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
